verdict.rationale: Rollbar's docs show items can be given an Owner and moved between Active, Resolved, Muted, and Archived statuses. That covers assigning, resolving, and ignoring (via Muted). Nothing in the evidence documents time-based snoozing or automatic reopening of a resolved item when it recurs. missing for 10: documented snooze (time- or count-based mute), documented automatic reactivation of resolved items on regression, independent or hands-on corroboration of the triage workflow.
